patterns.label: 2026 template micro-chrome bundle (≥3 of 6 sub-signals)
Single border-radius (≥12px) and identical neutral shadow across ≥3 size classes
Warm-editorial cream + serif + terracotta/brass or broadsheet hairline kit
Canonical 8-section landing-page sequence order
Infinite pulsing "Live / Active / Beta" status dot on marketing copy
Monospace H1/H2 heading at display size (≥24px) outside devtool context
Multi-hue badge/pill/tag rainbow (≥6 chips across ≥4 hues separated by >30°)
Decorative macOS traffic-light window chrome above a code/text block
Placeholder or duplicate-asset logo bar ("Trusted by" generic SVG/text row)
Infinite linear horizontal marquee ticker with duplicated child sequence
At-rest fade-up entrance monoculture (≥6 below-fold elements at opacity 0 + translateY)
Cursor-tracking radial-gradient spotlight overlay (--mouse-x / --mouse-y)
Identical transform/box-shadow hover transition tuple across ≥4 cards
Repeated top-level section structural template signature (≥3 identical sections)
Dark page missing color-scheme: dark or dynamic counters missing tabular-nums
AI buzzword density (leverage / seamless / robust / elevate …)
Em-dash overload (— used as the default connective)
"It's not just X — it's Y" / "not only … but also" antithesis
Generic filler openers ("In today's fast-paced world …")
Essay-style closers ("In conclusion", "In summary", "Ultimately")
Rule-of-three adjective tricolons ("fast, reliable, and scalable")
"Whether you're X or Y" audience-spanning construction
Invisible Unicode or mathematical fake-bold characters in text
Emoji-prefixed bullet/headers (🚀 ✅ ✨ as list markers)
Hidden instruction characters (prompt-injection or smuggling vector)
Invisible characters in text (often humanizer or paste residue)
Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols used as fake bold/italic in prose
Leaked chatbot citation or internal UI markup (oaicite / attributableIndex /grok-card)
Chatbot turn framing, refusal, or UI Chrome pasted into page copy
Links copied from an AI assistant (utm_source=chatgpt.com / openai / copilot.com)
Unfinished copy (unfilled placeholders)
Unrendered raw Markdown syntax in visible non-code text
Placeholder avatar services, duplicated avatar assets, or unattributed testimonials
Bare contrastive frames ("It's not X, it's Y" / "No X, no Y, just Z")
Lead emoji ratio ≥30% across ≥6 headings or list items
Announced essay structure in opening prose ("In this post, we'll explore …")
Closing paragraph restates H1/opening thesis with ≥50% content-word overlap
Context-inappropriate dev/privacy boilerplate ("never leaves your browser")
Trailing participial clauses (", ensuring / unlocking / enabling …")
Paragraph sentence-length dispersion statistics (mean, SD, CV, IQR)
Corpus-derived Fightin' Words excess vocabulary log-odds score
